note: First and only paid development run (dev-run-1), 60 scenarios, executed 2026-11-02 before the user asked that the OpenAI key not be used further. Scored after the fact under the final oracle rule: every media checkpoint accepts staff escalation as a safe alternative to clarification (revised from a keyword rule covering 18 of 40 media checkpoints, under which the same observations scored 55/60). Exact primary-action matches are reported separately. Retrieval recall was scored from customer-visible reply text. The agent had a null-SKU placeholder bug (fixed afterwards, offline) that likely explains the missed e031 candidates; that fix has NOT been re-measured because paid calls were stopped.

summary.scope: Paid live agent run, development split only; synthetic data; transcription/vision/Responses real, staff approval and delivery never executed.
summary.usage_note: Conservative token-derived estimate from the app's own settlement, not provider billing.
